ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution; high-intensity (white/beige) pixels are localized exclusively at the distal tips and as sparse micro-mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Approximately 95% contiguous dark pigmentation. High-contrast geometric clusters (barnacles) mapped to the far-lateral coordinates of both lobes. Scattered, low-contrast grey circular 'ghost' blobs present on the interior surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute V-shaped notch; high vertical depth in the central bounding box relative to the horizontal width of the depression.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary; continuous high-frequency, moderate-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) extracted from the median notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature fitted to the trailing edge, exhibiting an upward parabolic sweep from the central notch to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast circular clusters of white/tan pixels (barnacle colonies) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Numerous circular greyish ring-like pixel clusters (scars) distributed across the dark surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple fine, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks/scratches) oriented semi-vertically on the medial-to-lateral region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on the trailing edge tips; multiple circular depigmented lesions ('ghost' scars) likely from past parasitic or epibiotic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of overlapping circular scars on the right lobe forming a distinct cluster near the upper-middle trailing edge.
